tables.description: Contains demographic and acquisition data for registered customers.

columns.name: acquisition_channel
columns.description: How the user was acquired (e.g., Organic, Paid Search, Referral).

tables.description: Contains transaction records for customer purchases.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the users table.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Current status of the order (completed, refunded, pending).

columns.name: gross_amount
columns.description: The total amount of the order before discounts.

columns.name: discount_amount
columns.description: The amount discounted from the order.

business_logic_rules: Net Revenue is calculated as: gross_amount - discount_amount.
Only consider orders with status = 'completed' when calculating total revenue or successful sales.
